national_news.title: Ministry of I&B Urges Media & Entertainment Sector to Target Global Audience at CII Summit
bullets: Joint Secretary in the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB), Senthil Rajan, addressed the 13th CII BIG Picture Summit in Mumbai, urging India's Media & Entertainment industry to focus on creating original Intellectual Property (IP) for global markets.
The MIB highlighted government single-window mechanisms for film permissions and strategic focus on the Animation, Visual Effects, Gaming, and Comics (AVGC) sector.
The newly operational Indian Institute of Creative Technologies (IICT) at a temporary campus in Mumbai aims to build industry-ready talent in Virtual Reality (VR), Extended Reality (XR), and gaming.

national_news.title: Election Commission Directs Special Summary Revision in 17 States and UTs
bullets: The Election Commission directed 17 States and Union Territories, including Bihar, to conduct a Special Summary Revision (SSR) of electoral rolls with January 1 as the qualifying date.
Eligible citizens can also send advance applications for enrolment for quarters corresponding to 2027 eligibility criteria.
The exercise aims to ensure maximum participation of young and first-time voters while preventing inclusion of ineligible persons.

national_news.title: APEDA Facilitates Export of Organic Palmyra Jaggery Powder to Bulgaria
bullets: APEDA facilitated the export of 1.755 metric tonnes of organic Palmyra Jaggery Powder from Erode district, Tamil Nadu, to Varna, Bulgaria.
The consignment is certified under the National Programme for Organic Production (NPOP) and EU standards.
The initiative covers 137 acres under organic cultivation and aims to introduce traditional Palmyra-based products to international markets.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Issues Notice on PIL Against Political Protests Inside Court Premises
bullets: The Supreme Court issued notices to prominent INDIA bloc leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav, regarding a petition filed by four lawyers against political demonstrations inside court premises on October 12.
A bench headed by Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant directed the preservation of CCTV footage and digital evidence, emphasizing that nobody can browbeat the top court.
The protest march was initially organized by opposition leaders to raise concerns over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Modi Interacts with India’s Asian Games 2026 Contingent
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with the Indian contingent that participated in the Asian Games 2026 in New Delhi, lauding their historic performances and monumental milestones.
India finished 4th in the medal tally at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in Japan, bagging 85 medals comprising 21 gold, 27 silver, and 37 bronze.
Key highlights included double gold victories by the men's and women's hockey teams, consecutive medals in cricket, and dual golds in kabaddi and archery.

national_news.title: National Sports Federations Conclave 2026 Focuses on Long-Term Excellence
bullets: Union Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya addressed the National Sports Federations (NSF) Conclave 2026 in New Delhi following India's 4th-place finish at the 2026 Asian Games.

The conclave served as a comprehensive review of Asian Games performance and assessed strategic preparations for upcoming major events including the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics and the 2030 Commonwealth and Asian Games.
Minister of State Raksha Khadse urged federations to align their operations with the Khelo India Mission and ensure active grassroots functionality at state and district levels.

national_news.title: Paras Health Ranks Joint Third Nationally in Private Multispeciality Hospital Groups
bullets: Paras Health has been ranked joint third alongside Manipal Hospitals in the National Group Ranking 2026 for private multispeciality hospital groups, with Apollo Hospitals placing first.
According to draft prospectus filings, Paras Health recorded a 42.5% increase in inpatient volumes and a 31.3% rise in surgeries between FY2024 and FY2026.
The healthcare sector update notes that ICRA projected a revenue growth of 13-15% in FY2027 for hospital companies following robust expansion in infrastructure and bed capacity.

bihar_news.title: Bihar News: Patna Zoo Toy Train Revival and JEEViKA Completes 20 Years
bullets: The toy train at Sanjay Gandhi Biological Park (Patna Zoo) is scheduled to resume operations in January 2027 after being discontinued since 2015.
The new toy train features a Vande Bharat-inspired design with one engine and four coaches, manufactured at the railway workshop in Samastipur.
Bihar's JEEViKA (Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society) completed 20 years, linking 1.81 crore households to 13.06 lakh self-help groups (SHGs) and facilitating ₹76,549 crore in bank credit.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Inaugurates Mega Leather, Footwear and Accessories Cluster in Muzaffarpur
bullets: Bihar inaugurated the Mega Leather, Footwear and Accessories Cluster at BIADA Industrial Area in Mahwal, Muzaffarpur, developed at a cost of ₹140.95 crore.
The project includes industrial infrastructure and a Common Facility Centre (CFC) to boost manufacturing, attract investment, and generate local employment.
The state government outlined targets to create local employment opportunities before 2030 and develop a 1,000 MW data centre.

bihar_news.title: Smriti Mandhana Appointed as UNICEF India Celebrity Advocate
bullets: Indian women's cricket team player Smriti Mandhana was named a Celebrity Advocate by UNICEF India on the International Day of the Girl.
The appointment aims to promote equal opportunities, health, well-being, and the empowerment of adolescent girls.
Smriti Mandhana is a recipient of the prestigious Arjuna Award and has previously supported various UNICEF and ICC campaigns focusing on gender equality.
